description: This file contains unit tests for grain placement filter registration, order, and execution in an Orleans-based project. It defines test classes, fixture setup, custom placement filter attributes, filter strategies, directors, and several test grain interface and class implementations with placement filter annotations.

classes.name: GrainPlacementFilterTests
classes.description: Contains test methods for placement filter behaviors, setup of test cluster, and verification of filter execution order and ordering logic.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Filesetup class for in-memory test cluster, handles initialization and disposal asynchronously.

classes.name: TestFilteredGrain
classes.description: Example grain class annotated with placement filter with specified order.

classes.name: IManagementGrain
classes.description: Interface for the management grain used to retrieve host information.

classes.name: ITestFilteredGrain
classes.description: Interface for test grains involved in placement filter tests.

classes.name: TestPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Base class implementing placement filter strategy with ordering capability.

classes.name: TestPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Director class executing the actual filter logic, releasing a semaphore to indicate triggering.

classes.name: OrderAPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Placement filter strategy with custom order for testing order in filters.

classes.name: OrderAPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Director for OrderA filters that adds 'A' to shared scratchpad.

classes.name: OrderBPlacementFilterStrategy
classes.description: Placement filter strategy with custom order for testing order in filters.

classes.name: OrderBPlacementFilterDirector
classes.description: Director for OrderB filters that adds 'B' to shared scratchpad.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the test cluster asynchronously.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Initializes the in-process test cluster with specific placement filters configured.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_GrainWithoutFilterCanBeCalled
methods.description: Test verifying that a grain without a placement filter can be called successfully.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_FilterIsTriggered
methods.description: Test to verify that the placement filter's director Filter method is invoked.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderAB12
methods.description: Test verifying the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestAB12FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderAB21
methods.description: Test verifying the order of filters applied to a grain of type ITestAB21FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderBA12
methods.description: Test verifying the order of filters for ITestBA12FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_OrderBA21
methods.description: Test verifying the order of filters for ITestBA21FilteredGrain.

methods.name: PlacementFilter_DuplicateOrder
methods.description: Test to ensure that having duplicate filter orders throws an exception.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Simple task method on grain classes used in tests.
